summary: Seek filtered document metadata pages by name and canonical binding order

schema.detail: Uses the existing document_canonical_latest index on the normal Store BINARY name schema; no new index or migration.

rules.detail: No claim or checkpoint rules change.

compatibility.detail: Preserves metadata, latest/history selection, literal prefix filtering, canonical version order and cursor predicates. Unicode range bounds retain the old substr residual, including its NUL semantics. No cross-call data cache or new snapshot pin.

downtime.detail: No additional restart work. Query specialization addresses optional-filter scans; a production person-read tail cause, CPU saving and latency saving have not been established.
